messages:
elaine: Postmortem follow-up: recurring quiet-hours pages from cache_p99. Need a small practical plan: owners, quick mitigations, validation. Keep it short.

matt: I'll own the rule audit and per-cluster baselines. Will produce a short CSV of thresholds. ETA 48h.

noah: I'll prototype a lightweight heuristic: combine p99 threshold + burst_guard (alerts/sec) + a short escalation leash. If small burst during quiet-hours, route to #alerts-digest. If sustained or burst large -> page. ETA 72h.

ops-bot: Reminder: any paging changes require runbook entry in infra/runbooks and review from @eng-sre.

elaine: quick mitigations: 1) temp quiet-hours routing 23:00-07:00 to digest channel (dry-run), 2) 10m host dedupe + 30m cluster leash, 3) feature-flagged threshold tweaks per cluster. Owners: matt (48h), noah (72h), elaine (dashboard + validation tomorrow AM).

matt: sample audit output plan: list alert, cluster, current_threshold, proposed_threshold, risk_note. I'll attach PR with feature flag.

noah: sketch for heuristic (pseudo): if p99 > threshold AND (alerts/sec_cluster < burst_guard) -> post digest. else -> page. burst_guard default 0.2 alerts/sec. dedupe key host|alert, host cooldown 10m.

elaine: validation metrics small set: quiet_hours_pagers, total_alerts, uniq_hosts_alerting, pages_per_incident. Target: reduce quiet_hours_pagers by 80% without missed criticals in two weeks.

ops-bot: Auto: add runbook PR link when ready.

matt: starting audit now, will post short update when PR is ready.

noah: prototype pushed to staging behind flag. running smoke tests.

elaine: weekly quick check Friday 09:00 PT. keep updates one-line. thanks :white_check_mark:
